name: John Ugbe
headline: I turn ideas into products people use.
summary: I work across product discovery, scoping, architecture, and engineering to build software that solves real problems and supports business goals.
bio: I enjoy the space where product ideas meet real engineering constraints. I work alongside product, design, and backend teams to take features from requirements through implementation and delivery. My experience spans web, mobile, and connected devices; my approach stays grounded in curiosity, ownership, and practical problem-solving.
